title: Oven Roasted Vietnamese Minari Bun Thit Nuong
description: A fresh and light Vietnamese dish featuring minari and served with rice noodles, this vegetarian friendly meal is perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Cut the minari into 2 inch pieces and place on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Drizzle the sesame oil over the minari and sprinkle with salt and black pepper.
Roast the minari in the oven for 15 minutes, or until tender and lightly browned.
While the minari is roasting, cook the rice noodles according to the package instructions.
Cut the tofu into small cubes and pan fry until golden brown.
In a small bowl, whisk together the soy sauce, fish sauce, lime juice, and grated ginger.
To assemble the dish, place the cooked noodles on a plate, top with the roasted minari, tofu, and drizzle with the soy sauce mixture.
